reason: Nobody in my kindergarten chat or Telegram group has mentioned Kiddo yet, so at most I would download the free version and see whether my child even likes it. I would not pay for another phone app on an ad I saw myself, and the free letters and numbers might be enough anyway.
objection: It is still more phone time. I already fight to take the phone away after cartoons, and I am not sure 10 minutes really stays 10 minutes, or that an app teaches better than me or the kindergarten teacher with a notebook.
would_change_my_mind: A few mothers in my kindergarten group saying their child actually learned the letters with it and that the time limit really stops the app, so the child does not cry for more.
